factories.name: new_receive_messages_step
factories.description: Long-poll one queue for up to ten messages with their bodies, receipt handles, receive counts, and message attributes, hiding each received message from other consumers for its visibility timeout.

inputSchema.description: ReceiveMessagesInput selects one queue and how long and how many messages to wait for.

maxMessages.description: MaxMessages is the most messages to receive, from 1 to 10; zero uses the connection's maxMessagesPerReceive.

queueUrl.description: QueueURL is the queue URL, such as https://sqs.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/orders; blank uses the connection's defaultQueueUrl.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: VisibilityTimeoutSeconds hides each received message from other consumers for this many seconds, from 0 to 43200; nil uses the queue's own visibility timeout.

waitTimeSeconds.description: WaitTimeSeconds is how long to wait for a message to arrive, from 0 to 20 seconds; nil uses the connection's receiveWaitSeconds, and 0 returns at once.

factories.name: new_delete_message_step
factories.description: Acknowledge one received message by deleting it from its queue with the receipt handle of its latest delivery, so SQS does not deliver it again; repeating an attempt is safe.

messageId.description: MessageID optionally names the message in the Result and receipt; it is not sent to SQS.

queueUrl.description: QueueURL is the queue the message came from; blank uses the connection's defaultQueueUrl.

receiptHandle.description: ReceiptHandle is the handle of the message's latest delivery, from receiveMessages.

factories.name: new_change_message_visibility_step
factories.description: Release one received message back to the queue at once with a zero timeout, or hide it for longer while the Flow keeps processing it, by setting its visibility timeout from now.

inputSchema.description: ChangeMessageVisibilityInput releases one received message or hides it for longer.

messageId.description: MessageID optionally names the message in the Result and receipt; it is not sent to SQS.

queueUrl.description: QueueURL is the queue the message came from; blank uses the connection's defaultQueueUrl.

receiptHandle.description: ReceiptHandle is the handle of the message's latest delivery, from receiveMessages.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: VisibilityTimeoutSeconds hides the message for this many seconds from now, from 0 to 43200. Zero releases it to other consumers at once. SQS caps a message's total in-flight time at 12 hours from its first receive.
